caseName: Mayor of Vicksburg v. Vicksburg Water Works Co.
caseNameFull: The Mayor and Aldermen of the City of Vicksburg v. Vicksburg Water Works Company
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Southern District of Mississippi.
attorneys: Mr. T. C. Catchings, Mr. O. W. Catchings and Mr. George Anderson for the appellants., Mr. Joseph Hirsh and Mr. J. C. Bryson for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of Bayard v. Lombard, 9 How. 530; Payne v. Niles, 26 How. 219; Indiana v. Liverpool, London & G. Ins. Co., 109 U. S. 168, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of Mississippi.
